Enable face authentication to automatically unlock your login keyring or KWallet on login. This securely stores your password sealed in the TPM when available, or encrypted with AES-256-GCM using a root-only master key. Face auth sets PAM_AUTHTOK for pam_gnome_keyring or pam_kwallet5 depending on your desktop.
